Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You crouch beside the overturned cup and follow the scrape across the floor, piecing together what moved through the room.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
Ten minutes.
Target / range / shape
One accessible scene or object; 10 minutes
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Facts must be available from the evidence, never invented by the card. Correct examination reveals obvious clues without a roll; only consequential uncertainty calls for this card.

Weak
Learn one supported fact.
Standard
Learn two supported facts.
Strong
Learn three supported facts.
